people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: “ ‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which Yahweh has spoken to Moses—
translations.bsb: Now if you stray unintentionally and do not obey all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses—
translations.kjv: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
